justification: Redefines one read-only probe (DQ-145) and the matching ledger row and outreach claim wording, to measure the citation the page actually shows after the user's 2026-10-12 decision.

break_it.scenario: A rule whose clause number is hidden and whose page check is unresolved would be counted as proven by a looser definition.
break_it.what_happens: The outreach claim would pass while the page shows a citation nothing has proven.
break_it.how: The probe counts any row where neither the shown clause (proven/imprecise) nor the page (on_page/moved/read_by_person) is proven, plus every unchecked row.

post_merge.manual_verify: DQ-145 reads 6,392; dq_check coverage OK (148 rows).
